questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Chairman of the BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Harvansh Chawla.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Harvansh Chawla, a senior lawyer and international trade expert, has been appointed as Chairman of the BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harvansh Chawla has been appointed as Chairman of the BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI).**
 
• His leadership focuses on strengthening trade, investment, and economic cooperation among BRICS and BRICS Plus nations.
 
• Chawla’s vision includes reducing trade barriers, fostering cross-border partnerships, and promoting innovation in various sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI)__

 __
 
• Aims to promote trade and economic growth among BRICS nations and emerging economies.
 
• Helps foster collaboration and partnership across sectors such as finance, technology, and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• BRICS and BRICS Plus__
 __
 
• BRICS includes Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
 
• BRICS Plus includes countries beyond BRICS, focusing on enhanced collaboration with emerging economies.
 
 
 
• Harvansh Chawla’s Background__
 
 
• A senior lawyer with expertise in international trade law and policy.
 
• Known for his work in fostering cross-border trade relations and economic development.

questions.question: In May 2020, who was appointed as India's Ambassador and Permanent Representative to the United Nations in New York?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**T.S. Tirumurthy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **T.S. Tirumurthy** was appointed as **India's Ambassador and Permanent Representative to the United Nations in New York** in **May 2020**.
 
• This appointment was made following the retirement of **Syed Akbaruddin**, who previously held the position of India's Permanent Representative to the United Nations.
 
• Tirumurthy is an experienced diplomat and has served in various capacities in India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA).
 
• Before his appointment as Permanent Representative to the UN, Tirumurthy served as the **Secretary (Economic Relations) at the MEA**, where he was involved in India's economic diplomacy and international economic engagements.
 
• His appointment highlights India's commitment to actively participating in global diplomacy and multilateral platforms like the United Nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Syed Akbaruddin:**
 
 
• Syed Akbaruddin served as India's Permanent Representative to the United Nations from **2016 to 2020**.
 
• He was known for his proactive diplomacy and played a key role in advocating India's interests at the United Nations.
 
• Akbaruddin retired from the Indian Foreign Service in April 2020, paving the way for the appointment of T.S. Tirumurthy.
 
 
 
• **India at the United Nations:**
 
 
• India has been an active member of the **United Nations** since its inception in **1945**.
 
• India is one of the founding members of the UN and has consistently contributed to peacekeeping operations, development initiatives, and global discussions on international issues.
 
• India's Permanent Mission to the UN in New York represents India's interests in various UN organizations and committees.
 
 
 
• **Role of Permanent Representative to the UN:**
 
 
• The Permanent Representative acts as the chief diplomat representing the country at the United Nations.
 
• They are responsible for participating in UN General Assembly sessions, Security Council meetings, and other key diplomatic negotiations.
 
• The Permanent Representative also plays a crucial role in shaping global policies and advocating for their country's stance on international issues.
 
 
 
• **Important Developments Under T.S. Tirumurthy:**
 
 
• During his tenure, India continued its efforts to secure a permanent seat at the **United Nations Security Council (UNSC)**.
 
• He also led India's participation in discussions on **climate change, counter-terrorism, and sustainable development**.
 
• India's role in multilateral organizations like the **G20** and **BRICS** was further strengthened under his representation.

questions.question: Who among the following legal luminaries was appointed as the Queen's Counsel for England and Wales in January 2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Harish Salve**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harish Salve** was appointed as the **Queen's Counsel (QC)** for England and Wales in **January 2020**, an honor that recognizes a lawyer's excellence in advocacy in the higher courts.
 
• He became one of the very few Indian-origin lawyers to achieve this prestigious designation in the legal profession of the UK.
 
• The title of Queen's Counsel is awarded to barristers and solicitors who have demonstrated excellence in advocacy and are considered experts in their legal field.
 
• Harish Salve is a prominent Indian lawyer who has represented India in international legal cases, including the famous **Kulbhushan Jadhav case** at the **International Court of Justice** (ICJ).
 
• His appointment as Queen’s Counsel highlights his global recognition for his legal expertise and contributions to the field of law.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Harish Salve:**
 
 
• Harish Salve was born in **India** in 1955 and is one of the most well-known lawyers in the country.
 
• He specializes in **constitutional law, commercial law, and arbitration** and has worked on several high-profile cases in India and abroad.
 
• He served as the Solicitor General of India from **1999 to 2002**.
 
• Salve is known for charging a token fee of just ₹1 for representing India in the Kulbhushan Jadhav case at the ICJ.
 
 
 
• **Queen’s Counsel (QC):**
 
 
• It is a prestigious title awarded to barristers and solicitors in the UK and Commonwealth countries.
 
• Lawyers who become QCs are referred to as "silks" due to the silk gowns they wear.
 
• It signifies a lawyer’s excellence in advocacy and their ability to handle complex and high-profile cases in higher courts.
 
 
 
• **Other Prominent Indian Lawyers:**
 
 
• **Fali S. Nariman:** A senior advocate in the Supreme Court of India, known for his expertise in constitutional law.
 
• **Gopal Subramaniam:** A former Solicitor General of India, with a reputation for handling significant cases in constitutional and commercial law.
 
• **Mukul Rohatgi:** A senior advocate who also served as the Attorney General of India from 2014 to 2017.
 
 
 
• **Kulbhushan Jadhav Case:**
 
 
• Harish Salve represented India in the case of **Kulbhushan Jadhav**, an Indian citizen sentenced to death in Pakistan.
 
• The case was brought before the **International Court of Justice (ICJ)**, where Salve argued for Jadhav’s right to consular access under the **Vienna Convention**.
 
• In **July 2019**, the ICJ ruled in favor of India, ordering Pakistan to grant consular access and review the death sentence.

questions.question: The National Assembly of the Republic of Mauritius had unanimously elected ______ as the President of Mauritius in December 2019.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prithvirajsing Roopun**__.

__
 
• **The National Assembly of the Republic of Mauritius had unanimously elected Prithvirajsing Roopun as the President of Mauritius in December 2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Assembly of the Republic of Mauritius has unanimously elected Prithvirajsing Roopun, as the new President of the island nation.
 
• He was the former** arts and culture minister of the country. **
 
• In Mauritius, Prime Minister is head of government and holds most political power while the president is head of state and has no executive role, and is considered a guardian of the constitution.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister in India:**

 
 
• Prime Minister is the head of the government while the** President is the head of the State** of the Republic of India.
 
• **Article 75** says that the Prime Minister shall be appointed by the President.
 
• **Oath, Term, and Salary**
 
 
• The term of the Prime Minister is not fixed and he holds office during the pleasure of the President.​
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ameenah Gurib-Fakim was the 6th President of Mauritius from 2015 to 2018.
 
• Rajkeswur Purryag served as 5th President of Mauritius from 2012 to May 2015. 
 
• Pravind Kumar Jugnauth is the current Prime Minister of Mauritius.
